Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're excited to move the POC to a short pilot with a handful of production calls. Before we sign the SOW, our finance team asked whether Redwood can support a quarterly invoicing cadence and Net-90 payment terms for the pilot period (60 days afterwards is okay to consider for ramp).

Quick context: Novara runs consolidated monthly payments for vendors of our core platform; however, for short pilots we consolidate into a single quarterly remit to align with procurement cycles. If Redwood can do quarterly invoices (one per quarter) with Net-90, we can accelerate the signature and start dates.

I've attached a proposed invoice schedule (one line per quarter) and the signed SOW. Let me know if this is something you can do or if you need more info from finance.

Thanks,
Sarah

Hi Sarah — appreciated the clarity and the SOW.

Short answer: this is not our standard for self-serve or standard hosted accounts, but we do approve bespoke invoicing/payment rhythms for enterprise pilots in some cases. There are two levers we typically evaluate: (1) credit/risk (does finance require collateral or a prepayment), and (2) commercial tradeoffs (we often ask for a modest revenue commitment or an introductory discount to offset extended float).

If you're open to that framing, I'll escalate internally with the invoice schedule and SOW and ask for an executive exception for Net-90 + quarterly remit during the pilot. Can you confirm the exact billing entity and whether Novara needs PO numbers on the invoice? Also copying Tom in case finance wants to add anything.

Best,

Vanessa / Marcus — please see inbound from Novara (below). Quick summary and ask:

Summary:
- Account: Novara Health (DN-8731). Pilot SOW signed; start target: 6/1/26.
- Request: Quarterly invoicing (one invoice per quarter) + Net-90 payment terms for pilot period only.
- Attachments: proposed invoice schedule and signed SOW (attached).

Commercial tradeoffs proposed (from my side):
- Pilot ARR is ~$45k total for three months.
- I'd recommend approving quarterly invoices for the pilot if we get Net-60 instead of Net-90 or if we pair Net-90 with a 5% prepayment or 3% introductory discount.

Risk considerations (finance):
- Extended float increases collection risk. Marcus — do you need a paper trail/PO or additional credit checks?
- If we approve Net-90 without offset, we should require exec sign-off on collections SLA and set a firm renewal invoicing cadence (monthly) post-pilot.

Request: Can we get an exec exception to allow quarterly invoices + Net-90 for this pilot under the conditions below? Please respond with Approve / Approve with conditions / Decline. If Approve, please list required conditions.

Proposed conditions (suggested):
1) Net-90 approval only if (a) Novara signs the attached SOW now, and (b) a 5% prepayment or a 3% one-time pilot discount is applied.
2) Finance to require PO number and remittance instructions on invoice.
3) Collections holdback: if invoices are unpaid past Net-120, suspend pilot access (standard).

Attachments: Novara_invoice_schedule_proposal.pdf (stub), SOW_Novara_060126_signed.pdf (stub)

Thanks — I can be available for a quick call if helpful.

Regards,
Rishi
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Rishi / Marcus — thanks for the clear summary and proposed mitigations. I agree with granting a controlled exception for this pilot with the following binding conditions: 

1) Approve quarterly invoicing cadence for the pilot period only.
2) Approve Net-90 on condition Novara provides a single 5% prepayment (applied to first invoice) OR we apply a 3% one-time pilot discount (your choice, Novara). Please confirm which they select before you finalize the SOW execution.
3) Finance (Marcus) to require a PO number on the invoice and to run a one-time credit verification.
4) Add a clause to SOW: billing reverts to monthly terms upon renewal unless explicitly amended by finance.
5) If invoice > Net-120, Redwood may suspend access until remediation steps completed.

Marcus — please confirm you can operationalize the PO & credit check and that collections will be ready to engage on Net-120 enforcement. Once Marcus confirms, Rishi, you have approval to sign the exception and close the deal contingent on Novara selecting prepayment vs discount.

Vanessa Ortiz
